details: The package's preinstall hook (setup.mjs) downloads the Bun runtime from github[.]com/oven-sh/bun and uses it to execute a bundled 727KB heavily-obfuscated script (math_init.js) at install time. The script uses a custom string-array decoder and contains eval/Function-constructor and child_process calls, so its behaviour is hidden behind obfuscation. The package also depends on @or-sdk/base, @or-sdk/data-hub-svc, and @or-sdk/tags, which are part of a known-malicious dependency chain. Installing this package executes the obfuscated payload automatically.

cwes.name: Inclusion of Functionality from Untrusted Control Sphere
